name: A Romance in Seven Dimensions
source:
A Romance in Seven Dimensions is a kinetic visual novel about a young man navigating a world both familiar and alien.

Walt is struggling; with college coursework, with connections, and with the disorienting math of higher dimensions. Things take a stranger turn when he’s assigned a private tutor: a mysterious, ghostly girl from the seventh dimension. She's supposed to be helping him. But she delights in teasing him. Is it...flirting?

This is a story about learning to love through letters, through dreams, and through the flicker of impossible messages. A slow-burn sci-fi romance told through text boxes, phantom voices, and soft, surreal visuals. 

[from [url=https://spidertreegames.itch.io/a-romance-in-7-dimensions]itch.io[/url]]
